title: MIFR: A Modality-Invariant and Fair Representation Framework for Skin Disease Classification
abstract: arXiv:2608.18774v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Skin diseases represent a major global public health burden, yet machine learning tools developed to assist in their diagnosis suffer from two critical limitations: reliance on only one modality for diagnosis and systematic performance disparities across skin tones. While existing approaches address each challenge separately, this work proposes a modality-invariant framework with fair representation (MIFR) for skin disease classification. The architecture pairs clinical photographs with dermoscopic images using ViT-based encoders, projecting each input into a high-dimensional embedding space via modality-specific projection heads. translated_title: MIFR：一种用于皮肤病分类的模态不变且公平的表征框架
translated_abstract: 皮肤病构成了全球重大的公共卫生负担，然而用于辅助诊断的机器学习工具存在两个关键限制：仅依赖单一模态进行诊断，以及在不同肤色间存在系统性性能差异。尽管现有方法分别解决每个挑战，本工作提出了一种具有公平表征的模态不变框架（MIFR）用于皮肤病分类。该架构使用基于ViT的编码器将临床照片与皮肤镜图像配对，通过特定模态的投影头将每个输入映射到高维嵌入空间。所得模型使用包含五个组件的多目标损失进行训练，包括用于分类的加权交叉熵、用于公平性的混淆和皮肤类型分类损失、用于类别对齐的每模态监督对比损失，以及用于临床和皮肤镜图像对齐的模态不变损失。
tldr: 本文提出了一种同时解决皮肤病分类中单模态依赖和肤色公平性问题的多模态框架，通过多目标损失实现模态不变性和公平表征。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes a multimodal framework that simultaneously addresses single-modality reliance and skin-tone fairness in skin disease classification, achieving modality invariance and fair representation via a multi-objective loss.
